reviews.title: Awesome CPU Cooler
reviews.comment: I gotta tell ya for the price and how this thing handles its AMAZING. Not only does this keep my CPU cooled at all times but the LCD screen is such a great touch. I love this cooler. Especially that my streaming PC can get under heavy load at times. But this cooler makes sure that my CPU doesn't go above 40C. Highly Recommend.
reviews.author: Jacob L.

reviews.title: Looks expensive, cools great
reviews.comment: I wanted a cooler with an LCD screen to show CPU temps (and funny GIFs) but didn't want to pay Corsair prices. This thing is a beast. It keeps my CPU temps in the low 60s while gaming. The screen is bright and the software is surprisingly easy to use compared to other brands. The fans can get a little loud at 100% speed, but you rarely need to run them that hard.
reviews.author: George

reviews.title: Mostly good but with 1 annoyance
reviews.comment: Solid cooling performance but the lcd turns off if you shutdown the very basic software so I can only give it 4 stars.
